title: Unique British Cod Shepherds Pie
description: A sweet and springy pescatarian-friendly dish featuring cod, sultanas, and a robata-grill twist, served in a tagliere vessel, inspired by British Cornish cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the robata-grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the cod fillets with salt, pepper, and robata-grill seasoning.
Grill the cod fillets for 4 minutes per side, until cooked through.
In a large pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the diced onion until softened.
Add the diced carrots to the pan and cook for an additional 5 minutes, until tender.
Stir in the frozen peas, sultanas, and cooked cod, breaking the cod into flakes as it's added.
Transfer the cod mixture to a tagliere vessel.
Spread the prepared mashed potatoes over the top of the cod mixture.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375 degrees Fahrenheit for 20 minutes, until the potatoes are golden brown.
